_readme: Which scene fills which store slot, in which theme, with which caption. Order = store order (the first three show in App Store search results). 'scene' + 'theme' name the capture store/captures/<device>/<lang>/<scene>_<theme>.png; 'copy' is a key in store/copy/copy.json; 'why' says why the caption is true of this exact screen. If you cannot write an honest 'why', drop the scene. Lists: 'phone' (iPhone, Android phone), 'compact' (iPhone Duo outer screen), 'large' (iPhone Duo inner screen), 'tablet' (iPad, Android tablet).

phone.why: The finished listing: real photos, the AI-written title, 'Done in 14 seconds' banner and the Publish on OLX button. 'Sell faster with AI / Photo in, listing out' is exactly this state.
The new-listing screen with three photos added, Camera / Gallery and 'Create with AI': add a photo, AI handles the rest.
The AI progress screen ticking off title, description and price on its own; the real run takes ~14 s ('Done in 14 seconds' on the next screen), so 'in seconds' is true.
The price card with the AI range, the category and the filled detail fields, every one editable: 'Review everything before posting / Edit text, price and details'.
'Published!' with the listing card, its OLX link and status, reached by the one Publish on OLX tap on the previous screen: 'Publish in one tap / A ready listing with zero extra work'.
My Ads with two connected OLX account tabs and six listings showing their status, unread messages and days left: 'All your ads in one place / Several OLX accounts, statuses and messages'.
A buyer chat about the guitar with two AI reply suggestions above the reply field: 'Answer buyers faster / AI suggests a ready reply'.
The buyer's message with a fake 'OLX Delivery' payment link carries the red 'possible scam' warning inside the bubble: 'Spot scams instantly / Suspicious links get flagged right away'.
